About DYONSYS

This sigil is a bit different from the others I have done in the past. DYONSYS is directed at making you much better at the games you like to play, mostly geared at FPS', but can be used for anything else. I picked 6 qualities about the ultimate traits I would want within my gaming mentality and created them to be a hypersigil. I have various ways of charging this one, but have picked the most efficient for you guys.

My Method of Charging

I pretend I am growing a bubble of intent (in this case, the visualization of my in-game character) in either my head or my hands. I begin to let it fill with all the feelings associated with the sigil, things like capturing objectives, gaining skill points, earning reputation or xp, becoming a god in your game basically, or even the feeling of becoming a "hacker". I continue to fill that "bubble" with those ideas as well as uttering DYONSYS (DEE-ON-SIS), combining the thoughts, feelings, and associations together with the system. Once I feel like I've put enough thought into it, I feel it move onto the central activation sigil and imagine it begin to glow bright as if it were combining with it. This can be done also physically, if you choose to make a physical "bubble" and then push it towards the activation sigil. Either method works for me. You can also think of it as sending signals to the sigil and each signal makes the sigil glow.

When you start to game, I'd suggest thinking about the sigil in the back of your head, continuously, as you game. Even if you have a second monitor, place the sigil on the opposing monitor so you can subconsciously see the system, if you aren't good enough to proactively imagine the sigil during gameplay.

Dead Trigger 2. I play it on iOS and via Facebook on my PC, and it's easily the game I've spent the most time on. While there are in-app purchases literally everywhere, none of them are required to enjoy the game. The only one I'd even think about purchasing is the money doubler or whatever, because the game is so great that I wanna give something to the developers. Regardless, the game's laid out pretty well and is mechanically sound, especially for an FPS on mobile devices. You can unlock everything in the game just by playing it, which is fantastic.

Well, it's not exactly recent, but a friend got me into Puzzles and Dragons not that long ago, and I've been addicted to it. It's free to play with IAP, but you don't need to pay to have fun and get pretty far in the game. It's pretty much battle bejeweled with waifus, and if you want to get far in the game you'll need to get lucky with your first pull a get a God from the Rare Egg Machine.
